description.value: Sai Plant Deli is a vegan-only Japanese fast-food spot in downtown Vancouver specializing in oyaki, a traditional Japanese filled steamed or baked bun. The business previously operated as Vegan Pudding & Co before rebranding, and sits on Richards Street in the heart of the city. Its exclusively plant-based menu makes it a distinctive quick-stop option for cyclists seeking vegan fare in the downtown core.
